governance.status: LEVEL 2 — TECHNICALLY VERIFIED, NOT EXTERNALLY ATTESTED
governance.description: Negative-Knowledge Database: every historical failure classified by method, problem, regime, observable, what failed, and what capability survived.

entries.failure: 22.65% error floor on exact analytical field
entries.root_cause: Cell-centered spatial sampling introduces half-cell MAC phase shift sqrt(2(1-cos(dx/2)))
entries.capability_demonstrated: Fourier solenoidal basis construction is exact; the error was in the sampling, not the basis
entries.resolution: W2 resolved by switching to MAC face-staggered projection (error -> <1e-12)

entries.failure: E_u approx 99.9% on unseen seeds — total failure
entries.root_cause: POD subspaces trained on different seeds occupy orthogonal Grassmannian subspaces (d_subspace > 1.5, mean principal angle > 45 deg). Random Fourier phases make each trajectory live in a different subspace.
entries.capability_demonstrated: POD is excellent for same-trajectory compression (E_u < 1e-12 on training data). Statistical observables (mean energy, spectral slope) are sometimes OK even when fields diverge.
entries.resolution: Never resolved for POD. Fourier/Stokes geometry-dependent bases bypass this entirely.

entries.failure: 100% representation breakdown (E_proj approx 99.9%), NOT evolution breakdown
entries.root_cause: Fourier amplitude spectra match across seeds (rho_amp approx 1.0), but physical field correlations drop to zero (rho_phys approx 0.0) due to random spatial phase shifts
entries.capability_demonstrated: Phase-amplitude decomposition diagnostic. Grassmannian subspace distance metric. Optimal translation alignment.
entries.resolution: Adaptive Fourier and Hybrid Fourier+POD bases eliminated representation breakdown (E_u < 0.5%).

entries.problem: Computational cost of nonlinear ROM evaluation
entries.failure: Triad tensor storage grows as O(r^2)-O(r^3), becoming the dominant bottleneck
entries.root_cause: Quadratic nonlinearity couples O(r^2) mode pairs; storing all triads explicitly is infeasible for large r
entries.capability_demonstrated: Triad counting and sparsity analysis methodology. Pareto frontier construction.
entries.resolution: W7 OntheFlyFFTEvaluator bypassed storage entirely via on-the-fly 3D FFT (memory: 131 MB -> 0.45 MB).

entries.failure: DISCARD — high particle interpolation overhead without accuracy gain
entries.root_cause: Particle advection + grid interpolation cost exceeded any accuracy benefit from Lagrangian tracking
entries.capability_demonstrated: Lagrangian particle advection infrastructure exists and works. Hybrid Euler-Lagrange methodology is valid.

entries.problem: Memory reduction via sparse triad pruning
entries.failure: DISCARD — severe error blowup at r > 248
entries.root_cause: Removing small triads breaks energy conservation and introduces catastrophic aliasing
entries.capability_demonstrated: Proved that triadic energy conservation is non-negotiable.
entries.resolution: On-the-fly FFT evaluator maintains all interactions implicitly.

entries.problem: Improving Stokes ROM with POD correction modes
entries.failure: DISCARD — loses transferability (reverts to seed-dependent behavior)
entries.root_cause: Adding POD modes re-introduces data dependence that Stokes eigenmodes were designed to avoid
entries.capability_demonstrated: Confirmed that geometry-based + data-based hybridization destroys the transferability advantage.

entries.problem: Local grid-based correction of Stokes ROM
entries.failure: DISCARD — high memory and computational overhead
entries.root_cause: Local correction requires storing full-grid residual fields, negating ROM memory advantage
entries.capability_demonstrated: Local residual computation infrastructure works correctly.

entries.problem: Optimal wall-shear-targeted basis via resolvent analysis
entries.failure: DISCARD — expensive offline SVD, speedup dropped to 0.95x
entries.root_cause: Resolvent requires solving large dense SVD per wavenumber pair
entries.capability_demonstrated: Resolvent response mode computation gives theoretically optimal forcing-response characterization.
entries.resolution: SeparableChannelEigenbasis achieved similar improvement without resolvent cost.

entries.problem: Improving global velocity accuracy via wall-gradient weighting
entries.failure: DOWNGRADED — degraded global velocity accuracy (E_u > 1.0) under matched channel BCs
entries.root_cause: Over-prioritizing wall-gradient modes displaces bulk kinetic energy modes
entries.capability_demonstrated: Gradient-weighted mode selection correctly improves wall-shear (E_tau_w drops). Works for wall-shear observable, hurts global velocity.

entries.failure: W10 reported E_u=0.25 while W11 reported E_u=0.878 for same basis
entries.root_cause: W10 evaluated projection at t=0 (IC). W11 evaluated time-advanced ROM at t=T. NOT COMPARABLE.
entries.capability_demonstrated: Reconciliation methodology. V0 audit-governed evidence fingerprinting.

entries.failure: Best: E_proj=0.245 at r=200. Targets 10/5/2/1% NOT ACHIEVED at r=1152
entries.root_cause: Global separable basis has intrinsic high dimensionality for turbulent states
entries.capability_demonstrated: Anisotropic allocation methodology. Capacity curve measurement. Pareto frontier.
entries.resolution: W13 explored greedy oracle and multiscale alternatives.

entries.failure: Did not significantly beat G1 baseline
entries.root_cause: All share the same dictionary; only selection order differs. Dictionary itself lacks multiscale content.
entries.capability_demonstrated: Multiple ordering heuristics are implementable and testable.
entries.resolution: W13-G multiresolution dictionary added new elements, not just orderings.

entries.failure: Sealed reproduction: E_M1(210) = 0.6348, NOT the claimed 0.0485
entries.root_cause: Multiple governance failures in pre-V2 reports. The claimed breakthrough did NOT survive sealed reproduction.
entries.capability_demonstrated: Multiresolution solenoidal dictionary construction works. Nonorthogonal projection solver works. The mathematical framework is sound.

entries.root_cause: Global dictionary has intrinsic dimensionality preventing 5% within 1152 modes
entries.capability_demonstrated: Greedy oracle gives theoretical lower bound. Proves dictionary is the bottleneck.
entries.resolution: Richer dictionary or different paradigm needed.

entries.problem: Transfer to unseen initial conditions and forcing
entries.failure: H-IC: 5.2% (>5%). H-F: 5.4% (>5%). Strong 5% gate FAILED for 2/3 holdouts.
entries.root_cause: Basis designed for one IC/forcing regime does not transfer below 5%
entries.capability_demonstrated: Holdout evaluation framework works. H-Re (Re=500): 4.85% PASSED.
entries.resolution: Transfer requires larger dictionary or regime-specific adaptation.
